item.tib: gnas lung skabs chog thugs rje'i dpyang thags thar lam bder 'dren
item.coloph: rig 'dzin slob dpon chen po gyer spungs dran pa nam mkha'i ring lugs dri ma med pa 'dzin pa'i gtsang gi ru lag g.yung drung gling gi mkhan chen skal bzang bon gyi nyi ma bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rin po che yis yang dang yang du bkas bskul pa la brten te/ gyim shod shel brag seng ge rdzong nas spyan drangs pa'i shog ser la / rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal gyis spel ba dge'o//
